overview: The Medford Historical Commission evaluated several demolition requests, determining 141 Grant Avenue as historically significant while declining to impose a demolition delay on 73 Surry Street or 360-362 Salem Street. The Commission also reviewed plans to construct veteran housing at 321 Winthrop Street and selected Lawrence Estates as the target area for an upcoming survey grant.

items.title: Preferably Preserved Hearing: 73 Surry Street
items.summary: The Commission voted against finding 73 Surry Street preferably preserved, allowing requested renovation and demolition permits to proceed.

items.title: Significance Determination: 141 Grant Avenue
items.summary: The Commission voted that 141 Grant Avenue is historically significant and scheduled a public hearing for the November meeting.

items.title: Demolition Application: 360-362 Salem Street
items.summary: The Commission voted to pass on review for 360-362 Salem Street following previous design modifications approved by the city.

items.title: Demolition Application: 387-389 Main Street
items.summary: The Commission voted to accept the demolition application for 387-389 Main Street for formal review at a future meeting.

items.title: Project Update: 321 Winthrop Street
items.summary: The Veterans' Services Department presented plans to replace a structurally unsound historic building at 321 Winthrop Street with housing for veterans, and the Commission planned an upcoming site visit.

items.title: Survey and Planning Grant Priority Area
items.summary: The Commission selected the Lawrence Estates area north of Medford Square as the target neighborhood for the next state survey and planning grant application.

items.title: Zoning Incentives and Cemetery Project Updates
items.summary: Commissioners discussed incorporating historic preservation incentives into city zoning policies and received progress updates on the Cross Street Cemetery restoration project.
